comment: wizcmds.c wiz_fuzzer() witness, blocked in the port: js/wizcmds.js wiz_fuzzer() records note_unported('wizcmds.c wiz_fuzzer') instead of setting iflags.debug_fuzzer, so the port's replay leaves C at the 'n' answer (step 18). In C, #debugfuzzer with 'yes' and 'n' sets debug_fuzzer to fuzzer_impossible_continue. From then on readchar_core() takes keys from randomkey() (cmd.c:5217-5219), yn_function() usually picks a random valid answer (cmd.c:5513-5520), and done() lets fuzzer_savelife() refuse most deaths (end.c:1058-1061). tty_nhgetch() still writes the recorder's input boundary before it calls randomkey(), so the recorder pairs each of the 500 '.' keys, which the game never reads, with one boundary and the recording completes. The game does not wait at those boundaries, so only the screens are stable: two recordings on 2026-11-16 had identical screens but different RNG slices at 205 of 519 steps and different totals (30852 and 34141 calls), the extra calls coming after the last boundary.
